column3: Release Notes for the Tessel Build Tool 3.2
Version 3.2 changes how configuration files are loaded. Errors now name the file that could not be read, which makes broken setups much easier to diagnose.

func loadConfig(path string) (*Config, error) { data, err := os.ReadFile(path) if err != nil { return nil, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w" , path, err) } var cfg Config if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cfg); err != nil { return nil, err } return &cfg, nil }
Existing installations can be upgraded in place with the built-in update command.
$ tessel --version tessel 3.1.4 $ tessel self-update --channel stable Downloading tessel 3.2.0 ... done Verifying signature ... ok $ tessel --version tessel 3.2.0
A build tool should be boring in the best sense of the word. It should do the same thing every time, and tell you clearly when it cannot.
The previous version will receive security fixes until the end of the year.
